Henry Buron

I'm a Robotics Software Engineer at Swarmbotics AI in Phoenix, AZ. Before that I interned with the Robotic Mobility group at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory.

My work centers on robotic manipulation and navigation — writing production C++ and Python against libraries like OpenCV and Eigen, in Linux environments. I care most about code that stays robust when it leaves the lab.

I'm interested in autonomous systems, SLAM, path planning, and mobile robots.
